# Botanical garden visit

A free afternoon among the glasshouses. The palm house was warm and humid, the alpine rockery was in bloom and the herb beds had labels with the old names. The children liked the carnivorous plants and the pond with the goldfish.

The cafe by the lake closes at five. Entrance is free, and the gates shut at sunset. Remember to bring a hat, because there is little shade on the main avenue.
